title.value: NL-PS-L4-A - Level 4a: Two minimal GBBs per section - Fixed token per patient

description.value: The serving system provides an NL-PS for its level 4a test patient, in which every mandatory section except Medication summary has at least two entries that refer to generic building blocks (GBBs) in the document, and has a narrative, and Medication summary has no entries, and has an emptyReason and a narrative. Conformancelab sends the bearer token you enter at test setup to your server. Use a token issued by your own system that gives access to your level 4a test patient, and only to that patient. Without a token the server may return the Patient Summaries of several patients; the script then tests the first one. Implementation Guides: NL-PS https://ig.nictiz.nl/nlps/ and generic building blocks (GBB) https://ig.nictiz.nl/gbb/
